caption: The template we picked, public at once on the default subdomain with no publish step. It is a volunteer website full of lorem ipsum, and the Free plan adds a Powered by systeme.io badge.
Our opt-in test stopped here: the form checks the email domain and refused a made-up example.com address. No contact was added, so the opt-in flow itself is untested.
Changing the headline to Get the free Test Co e-book worked at once. From new funnel to edited page took about 6 minutes.
The automation rule: when someone subscribes through the opt-in form, add the tag ebook-optin. On the Free plan this one rule and this one tag already fill both counters.
A campaign needs a sender email address, and the list was empty with no way to add one in this dialog. We added none, so no email was tested.
Free at $0 for 2,000 contacts, then Startup $17, Webinar $47 and Unlimited $97 a month. After one opt-in flow our counters read Tags 1/1 and Automation rules 1/1.
